text: ここは　５かい…　ボスの　いる　ところ　まで　まだまだ　あるぜ！

structure.jp: ボスの　いる　ところ　まで
structure.en: to the place where the boss is

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ボスの　いる　ところ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which one; inside such a phrase の can stand in for が. ボスの　いる　ところ = 'the place where the boss is'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end of a sentence is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. まだまだ　あるぜ = 'there's still a long way to go, pal'.
